## {.toolbar }

```{python}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

import sys, os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "..")))
from src.backend.backend_functions import *

initialize_data()

card_stats = get_data("card_game_winrate_per_season").copy()

# The Dash page assumed this column existed; derive it if the backend stops
# providing it, so a schema change fails in Python rather than silently in OJS.
if "game_win_rate" not in card_stats.columns:
    card_stats["game_win_rate"] = card_stats["games_won"] / card_stats["games_played"]

card_stats["season_id"] = card_stats["season_id"].astype(str)
card_stats = card_stats[
    ["season_id", "card_name", "games_played", "games_won", "game_win_rate"]
].sort_values("games_played", ascending=False)


# --- model_stats: adjusted win rates from the GLMs ---------------------------
# ManaCore card_impact_analysis.py, fit once over all seasons:
#   v0: win ~ has_card + elo_diff               (player strength)
#   v1: win ~ has_card + elo_diff + archetype   (+ archetype)
# Win rate = overall game win rate + <v>_win_rate_lift_prob, the card's average
# lift over every real game (each game predicted with and without the card,
# keeping its actual archetype and elo_diff).
MODELS = ["v0", "v1"]

archetype_games = get_data("archetype_game_winrate")
archetype_games = archetype_games[archetype_games["season_id"].astype(str) == "Season-All"]
overall_win_rate = archetype_games["games_won"].sum() / archetype_games["games_played"].sum()

# Games come from the raw Season-All stats so both views count the same games;
# fall back to the model's own sample size where a card has no raw row. Joined on
# the Scryfall id because some names appear twice (different printings).
raw = get_data("card_game_winrate_per_season")
raw_all = raw[raw["season_id"].astype(str) == "Season-All"]

glm = get_data("output_glm_only")
frames = []
for v in MODELS:
    part = glm[glm[f"{v}_win_rate_lift_prob"].notna()].copy()
    part["game_win_rate"] = overall_win_rate + part[f"{v}_win_rate_lift_prob"]
    part = part[part["game_win_rate"].between(0, 1)]
    part["model"] = v
    frames.append(part[["model", "card_id", "card_name", "n_games", "game_win_rate"]])

model_stats = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True).merge(
    raw_all[["scryfallId", "games_played", "games_won"]],
    left_on="card_id", right_on="scryfallId", how="left"
)
model_stats["games_played"] = model_stats["games_played"].fillna(model_stats["n_games"])
model_stats["season_id"] = "Season-All"
model_stats = model_stats[
    ["model", "season_id", "card_name", "games_played", "games_won", "game_win_rate"]
]
model_stats = model_stats.astype(object).where(pd.notna(model_stats), None)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Current cube = the newest cube_mainboard snapshot. Matched by name so a
# different printing of the same card still counts as in the cube.
mainboard = get_data("cube_mainboard")
current_cube = sorted(
    mainboard.loc[mainboard["timestamp"] == mainboard["timestamp"].max(), "card_name"]
    .dropna().unique()
)

# 'Season-All' is a precomputed aggregate row in the source data; pin it first.
seasons = sorted(card_stats["season_id"].unique())
if "Season-All" in seasons:
    seasons.remove("Season-All")
    seasons.insert(0, "Season-All")

ojs_define(
    seasons=seasons,
    # NB: do not name this `cards` -- that shadows the OJS stdlib `cards`
    # reactive that Quarto uses to autosize Plot.plot() calls in dashboards.
    card_stats=card_stats,
    model_stats=model_stats,
    model_labels={"v0": "Player strength (v0)",
                  "v1": "Player strength + archetype (v1)"},
    current_cube=current_cube,
)
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
// The model is pooled over all seasons, so the season is pinned while it's on.
viewof season = Inputs.select(seasons, {
  label: "Season",
  value: seasons[0],
  disabled: useModel
})

viewof cardSearch = Inputs.text({
  label: "Search Card",
  placeholder: "Search card...",
  submit: false
})

viewof inCubeOnly = Inputs.toggle({
  label: "Only current cube",
  value: true
})

viewof minGames = Inputs.number([0, Infinity], {
  label: "Min Games Played",
  value: 10,
  step: 1
})

// Two checkboxes that behave like radio buttons which can also both be off:
// ticking one clears the other. Nothing ticked = raw win rate. The listener runs
// in the capture phase, before Inputs.checkbox recomputes its value.
viewof modelPick = {
  const input = Inputs.checkbox(Object.keys(model_labels), {
    label: "Adjust for",
    value: ["v0"],
    format: k => model_labels[k]
  });
  input.addEventListener("input", event => {
    if (!event.target.checked) return;
    for (const box of input.querySelectorAll("input[type=checkbox]")) {
      if (box !== event.target) box.checked = false;
    }
  }, true);
  return input;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cardsData = transpose(card_stats)
modelData = transpose(model_stats)
cubeSet = new Set(current_cube)

modelKey = modelPick[0] ?? null
useModel = modelKey !== null
rateLabel = useModel ? `Win Rate (adjusted, ${modelKey})` : "Game Win Rate"

// The number input yields null when cleared; treat that as no minimum.
filtered = {
  const query = (cardSearch ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const floor = minGames ?? 0;
  return (useModel ? modelData : cardsData).filter(d =>
    (useModel ? d.model === modelKey : d.season_id === season) &&
    (!inCubeOnly || cubeSet.has(d.card_name)) &&
    d.games_played >= floor &&
    (query === "" || String(d.card_name).toLowerCase().includes(query))
  );
}

avgWinRate = filtered.length ? d3.mean(filtered, d => d.game_win_rate) : 0
totalGames = d3.sum(filtered, d => d.games_played)
highPerformers = filtered.filter(d => d.game_win_rate > 0.55).length

// Mirrors the Plotly version: pad the observed range by 5pp, clamped to [0, 1].
yDomain = filtered.length
  ? [Math.max(0, d3.min(filtered, d => d.game_win_rate) - 0.05),
     Math.min(1, d3.max(filtered, d => d.game_win_rate) + 0.05)]
  : [0, 1]

// 100+ games is a stricter bar than the toolbar filter, so the leaderboard
// never shows a 100% card that was played twice.
topCards = filtered
  .filter(d => d.games_played >= 100)
  .sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.game_win_rate, b.game_win_rate))
  .slice(0, 5)

rateCell = x => htl.html`<span style="color: ${
  x > 0.55 ? "var(--bs-success)" : x < 0.45 ? "var(--bs-danger)" : "inherit"
}; font-weight: ${x > 0.55 || x < 0.45 ? 600 : 400}">${(x * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span>`
```

# Main Content



## Row {height="50%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: "Card Performance: Win Rate vs Games Played"
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 70,
  marginBottom: 50,
  style: {fontSize: "13px"},
  x: {label: "Games Played", grid: true, nice: true},
  y: {
    label: rateLabel,
    labelArrow: "none",
    domain: yDomain,
    tickFormat: ".0%",
    grid: true
  },
  color: {
     type: "linear",
    scheme: "RdYlGn",
    domain: yDomain,
    pivot: 0.5,
    legend: true,
    label: "Win Rate",
    tickFormat: ".0%"
  },
  r: {range: [3, 16]},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0.5], {
      stroke: "gray", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeOpacity: 0.6
    }),
    Plot.dot(filtered, {
      x: "games_played",
      y: "game_win_rate",
      r: "games_played",
      fill: "game_win_rate",
      stroke: "white",
      strokeWidth: 0.75,
      fillOpacity: 0.8,
      channels: {Card: "card_name"},
      tip: {format: {Card: true, x: ",.0f", y: ".1%", r: false, fill: false}}
    })
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Top Performing Cards (100+ Games)"
topCards.length === 0
  ? html`<p class="text-muted">No cards with sufficient games played.</p>`
  : html`<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;">
      ${topCards.map(d => html`
        <div style="padding: 10px 14px;
                    background: var(--bs-tertiary-bg);
                    border-left: 4px solid var(--bs-success);
                    border-radius: 5px;">
          <div style="font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px;">${d.card_name}</div>
          <div>
            <span style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--bs-success);">
              ${(d.game_win_rate * 100).toFixed(1)}%
            </span>
            <span style="font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.7;"> (${d.games_played} games)</span>
          </div>
        </div>`)}
    </div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Detailed Card Statistics"
Inputs.table(filtered, {
  // Model rates are pooled over all seasons, so the Season column adds nothing.
  columns: [...(useModel ? [] : ["season_id"]),
            "card_name", "games_won", "games_played", "game_win_rate"],
  header: {
    season_id: "Season",
    card_name: "Card Name",
    games_won: "Games Won",
    games_played: "Games Played",
    game_win_rate: useModel ? `Win Rate (${modelKey})` : "Game Win Rate"
  },
  format: {game_win_rate: rateCell, games_won: x => x == null ? "—" : x},
  align: {games_won: "right", games_played: "right", game_win_rate: "right"},
  sort: "game_win_rate",
  reverse: true,
  rows: 20,
  layout: "auto"
})
```
